column3: [disgusted] Eww! What's this sticky stuff he's spreading on us?
[calm, smug] Relax. It's just a peel-off mask. It never gets me.
[panicked] It's drying up! I can't move!
[shouting] Hold on to your heads, boys!
[screaming] Aah! It tore my head off!
[calm] Just the top. The rest of you is still down there.
[hopeful] So... we just fill back up?
[smug] Told you. Nothing reaches us down here.
[confident] I do. I'm salicylic acid. I slide into the pore, and melt the oil.
[puzzled] Doc, why do my blackheads keep coming back after a peel-off mask?

A peel-off mask only pulls off the top of the plug. The oil deeper in the pore stays, so it fills right back up. Try a salicylic acid cleanser or serum, a few times a week. It gets inside the pore and dissolves the oil. Give it a few weeks, and don't squeeze them.
